title: Elica — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Elica.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Pioneering Kitchen Innovation." Premium tier. Elica is one of the worlds largest range hood manufacturers, headquartered in Fabriano, Italy. Their NikolaTesla integrated cooktop-hood combines the cooking surface and ventilation in one unit. Elica brings Italian design flair to ventilation with hoods that function as kitchen sculptures.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Design-forward kitchens. Customers who want a statement range hood. NikolaTesla integrated solution buyers.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Elica:

• NikolaTesla — cooktop and hood integrated in one unit, no overhead hood needed

• Italian design heritage from Fabriano, Italy

• One of the worlds largest hood manufacturers — proven engineering

• Statement hoods that are kitchen art pieces

• Quiet operation with powerful extraction
